summary: Full RBAC (Owner vs Cashier) verification across backend (54 pytest cases) and frontend (owner + cashier UI flows). All 54 backend tests PASS: login payload shape for owner+cashier includes {id,email,name,role,tenant_id,access_token}; cashier tenant_id equals owner tenant_id; 41 forbidden endpoints correctly return 403 for cashiers (analytics, product mutations, settings mutations, gemini, branding, expenses, promotion mutations, exports, ai, whatsapp, online orders, customer reminders, users management); 9 cashier-allowed endpoints return 200 (products read, categories, settings read, branding read, promotions read/preview, transactions list, customers list); shift open→transaction create→shift close cashier flow works; owner user management flow (create cashier, list, PUT password, DELETE + 401 after) passes. Frontend: owner nav shows all 15 items with 'Pemilik Toko' badge; /staff CRUD works (create cashier, toast, list row visible); cashier login lands on / with 'Kasir' badge; sidebar shows ONLY nav-pos/nav-shifts/nav-transactions and none of the 12 owner-only nav items are in DOM; all 7 direct-URL owner routes (/settings,/analytics,/staff,/inventory,/expenses,/customers,/online-orders) redirect back to /.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a very large monolith with ~37 endpoints newly guarded by Depends(require_owner). Consider splitting into routers (analytics.py, settings.py, ai.py, users.py, whatsapp.py) to keep files <700 lines and improve maintainability.
Transaction item schema requires both 'quantity' and 'qty' (422 if only 'quantity' is sent). Consider consolidating on a single field name with a Pydantic alias to prevent client confusion.
test_credentials: Owner robaya05@gmail.com/admin123; Cashiers created dynamically e2e_cashier_{ts}@test.com/secret123 (some remain in DB from repeated test runs — cleanup optional).
seed_data_creation: Several E2E cashier users created under owner tenant during tests (auto-deleted by TestOwnerUserManagement.test_owner_reset_cashier_password_and_delete for the backend fixture cashier; the frontend-created cashier is left in the DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend/tests/test_rbac.py is the canonical RBAC regression suite. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_rbac.py -n 0` (module-scoped fixture requires serial execution since parallel xdist workers each try creating the same cashier email and fail with 'Email sudah terdaftar'). Transaction payload requires items to have BOTH 'quantity' and 'qty'.
